Sofia, I posted the bullets for June as a reply to your message in #coastal-team. They're only a draft in the channel. I haven't sent anything to June.

- **Rename:** Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb. It's the Mid-Atlantic home goods account.
- **Shared acronym:** "PHL" is also the shorthand for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, the Gulf Coast terminal account. Filtering on "PHL" in the morning report returns rows for both. Kwame flagged this in the channel on 17 Feb.
- **Saved report:** Moss's coverage digest from 18 May says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The old label makes the receiving supervisor search twice.
- **Cheat sheet:** Moss's Coastal cheat sheet still lists the account as "Covey & Lark Retail". I added that as a bullet because it needs the new name too.
- **Ask for June:** I wrote a suggested ask in the bullets: confirm who owns renaming the saved report, and whether the PHL filter can be disambiguated.

That digest is from 18 May, so I can't tell whether the report label has been fixed since. Check that before the note goes to June.
